cases.title: G-2 — Completing an already-`missed` occurrence is refused

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM recurrence_series WHERE id = '{{series_id}}' AND done_count = {{done_count}} AND missed_count = {{missed_count}}
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE series_id = '{{series_id}}' HAVING count(*) = {{task_count}}
SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE id = '{{task_id}}' AND status = 'missed' AND completed_at IS NULL
